NOTES

Update - 08152025
GitHub only works as a repository for app.R and data.
Signed up on shinyapp.io using UF email, free acct.


for running shiny app on GitHub using shinylive
used the instructions on this link:

https://hbctraining.github.io/Training-modules/RShiny/lessons/shinylive.html

it worked! But i have kept it private.

COMMENTS:
GitHub hosts only static content. 
shinylive compiles that app for computation locally on user side
it is slower than hosting using shinyapps.io, posit cloud connect, and others

Other options besides the two listed above, for loading shiny app to the web,
Heroku - https://www.john-mcallister.com/deploy-r-shiny-applications-on-heroku/
Digital Ocean - https://deanattali.com/2015/05/09/setup-rstudio-shiny-server-digital-ocean/
https://hosting.analythium.io/
Ploomber - https://docs.cloud.ploomber.io/en/latest/apps/shiny-r.html
https://polished.tech/
